description: With decidable equality of function and relation symbols at each arity, the finite literal test accepts exactly the ground literal problems having nonempty models.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.literalTest_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.literalTest Γ = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.HasModel Γ
